title: Many test failures when GPU does not support BF16

labels.name: module: cuda
labels.description: Related to torch.cuda, and CUDA support in general

labels.name: module: tests
labels.description: Issues related to tests (not the torch.testing module)

labels.name: triaged
labels.description: This issue has been looked at a team member, and triaged and prioritized into an appropriate module

body:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

We are running the PyTorch test suite on multiple architectures to verify the installation.

On Volta GPUs many tests fail with a similar cause: Using `bfloat16`.

E.g. `python test/inductor/test_online_softmax.py TestOnlineSoftmax.test_split_reduction`
> >       act, (code,) = run_and_get_code(torch.compile(torch.softmax), x, dim=-1)
> E       ValueError: not enough values to unpack (expected 1, got 0)

And prior to that warnings:
```
Online softmax is disabled on the fly since Inductor decides to
split the reduction. Cut an issue to PyTorch if this is an
important use case and you want to speed it up with online
softmax.

  warnings.warn(
/tmp/eb-sx0ralf9/tmpn8q57wph/lib/python3.12/site-packages/torch/_inductor/compile_fx.py:2177: UserWarning: Tesla V100-SXM2-32GB does not support bfloat16 compilation natively, skipping
```

Mostly the inductor tests are affected.

`test_adaptive_avg_pool2d_low_prec` contains some checks like `if not self.is_dtype_supported(dtype): continue` which likely fix that.   
It seems that this needs to be broadly done for any test using `torch.bfloat16`

### Versions

PyTorch 2.7.1 & 2.9.1
